Nepal -LRB- -LSB- Nepālhelp = no -RSB- -RCB- -RCB- -LSB- neˈpal -RSB- -RRB- , officially the Federal Democratic Republic of Nepal , is a landlocked central Himalayan country in South Asia .	Federal	Federal republic	landlocked	landlocked	South Asia	South Asia

Nepal is divided into 7 provinces and 75 districts and 744 local units including 4 metropolises , 13 sub-metropolises , 246 municipal councils and 481 villages .	7 provinces	List of provinces of Nepal	75 districts	List of districts of Nepal
It has a population of 26.4 million and is the 93rd largest country by area .	93rd largest country	List of countries by area
Bordering China in the north and India in the south , east , and west , it is the largest sovereign Himalayan state .	China	China	India	India	Himalayan state	Himalayan states
Nepal does not border Bangladesh , which is located within only 27 km -LRB- 17 mi -RRB- of its southeastern tip .	Bangladesh	Bangladesh
Neither does it border Bhutan due to the Indian state of Sikkim being located in between .	Bhutan	Bhutan	Sikkim	Sikkim

Nepal has a diverse geography , including fertile plains , subalpine forested hills , and eight of the world 's ten tallest mountains , including Mount Everest , the highest point on Earth .	diverse geography	Geography of Nepal	fertile plains	Terai	tallest mountains	List of highest mountains#List	Mount Everest	Mount Everest
Kathmandu is the nation 's capital and largest city .	Kathmandu	Kathmandu
It is a multiethnic nation with Nepali as the official language .	Nepali	Nepali language
The territory of Nepal has a recorded history since the Neolithic age .	Neolithic	Neolithic
The name `` Nepal '' is first recorded in texts from the Vedic Age , the era which founded Hinduism , the predominant religion of the country .	Hinduism	Hinduism	Vedic Age	Vedic Age
In the middle of the first millennium BCE , Gautama Buddha , the founder of Buddhism , was born in southern Nepal .	Buddhism	Buddhism	Gautama Buddha	Gautama Buddha
Parts of northern Nepal were intertwined with the culture of Tibet .	Tibet	Tibet
The Kathmandu Valley in central Nepal became known as Nepal proper because of its complex urban civilisation .	Kathmandu	Kathmandu	Kathmandu Valley	Kathmandu Valley
It was the seat of the prosperous Newar confederacy known as Nepal Mandala .	Newar	Newar people	Nepal Mandala	Nepal Mandala
The Himalayan branch of the ancient Silk Road was dominated by the valley 's traders .	Silk Road	Silk Road
The cosmopolitan region developed distinct traditional art and architecture .	art	Newa art	architecture	Architecture of Nepal
By the 18th century , the Gorkha Kingdom achieved the unification of Nepal .	Gorkha Kingdom	Gorkha Kingdom	unification of Nepal	unification of Nepal

The Shah dynasty established the Kingdom of Nepal and later formed an alliance with the British Empire , under its Rana dynasty of premiers .	Shah dynasty	Shah dynasty	Kingdom of Nepal	Kingdom of Nepal	British Empire	British Empire	Rana dynasty	Rana dynasty	premiers	Prime Minister of Nepal
The country was never colonised but served as a buffer state between Imperial China and Colonial India .	China	China	India	India	Imperial China	Imperial China
In the 20th century , Nepal ended its isolation and forged strong ties with regional powers .
Parliamentary democracy was introduced in 1951 , but was twice suspended by Nepalese monarchs in 1960 and 2005 .	Nepalese	Demographics of Nepal	Parliamentary democracy	Parliamentary democracy

The Nepalese Civil War resulted in the proclamation of a republic in 2008 , ending the reign of the world 's last Hindu monarchy .	Nepalese	Demographics of Nepal	republic	republic	Nepalese Civil War	Nepalese Civil War	Hindu	Hindu
Modern Nepal is a federal secular parliamentary republic .	parliamentary	parliamentary	republic	republic	federal	federal republic	secular	secular
It has seven states .	seven states	Nepalese Federal States

Nepal is a developing nation , ranking 144th on the Human Development Index -LRB- HDI -RRB- in 2016 .	developing nation	developing nation	144th	List of countries by Human Development Index	Human Development Index	Human Development Index
The country struggles with the transition from a monarchy to a republic .	republic	republic
It also suffers from high levels of hunger and poverty .	hunger	hunger

Despite these challenges , Nepal is making steady progress , with the government declaring its commitment to elevate the nation from least developed country status by 2022 .	least developed country	least developed country
Nepal also has a vast potential to generate hydropower for export .	hydropower	hydropower

Nepal 's foreign relations expanded after the Anglo-Nepal Treaty of 1923 , which was recognised by the League of Nations .	Anglo-Nepal Treaty of 1923	Nepal-Britain Treaty of 1923	League of Nations	League of Nations
After a Soviet veto in 1949 , Nepal was admitted to the United Nations in 1955 .	Soviet	Soviet Union	United Nations	United Nations
Friendship treaties were signed with the Dominion of India in 1950 and the People 's Republic of China in 1960 .	China	China	India	India	Dominion of India	Dominion of India

Nepal hosts the permanent secretariat of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation -LRB- SAARC -RRB- , of which it is a founding member .	South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation	South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation
Nepal is also a member of the Non Aligned Movement and the Bay of Bengal Initiative .	Non Aligned Movement	Non Aligned Movement	Bay of Bengal Initiative	Bay of Bengal Initiative

The military of Nepal is the fifth largest in South Asia and is notable for its Gurkha history , particularly during the world wars , and has been a significant contributor to United Nations peacekeeping operations .
